signals.why_routing: [Carryover] Jonah SightMap + Tour Scheduler add-on messaging unchanged. Layer 2: CEngrainSightMapWidget embed exists; delta remains live PMS rent on unit pins + tour handoff.
signals.signal_summary: [Carryover] Jonah Digital Engrain SightMap Experience + Tour Scheduler Integration — Core has embed foundation; delta is live per-unit pricing pins.

brief.what: SightMap siteplan with unit pins wired to live Entrata PMS rent and tour scheduler — not a static Engrain embed.
brief.benefits: Prospect Portal · Leasing Websites · Tour Scheduler · Open API pricing feed
brief.why_build: Jonah sells SightMap + tour booking as an add-on; Entrata can ship live unit economics competitors cannot without owning the PMS.

roi.summary: Live unit pricing on the siteplan lifts high-intent apply starts; delta is PMS-tied map UX atop existing Engrain widget.

numbers.formula: (Δ apply-start rate × avg monthly rent × vacancy days avoided per start) ÷ units
inputs: +0.5–1.0% lift on siteplan sessions that reach apply (roi-analyst midpoint)
$1,800 blended avg rent · 3 vacancy days avoided per incremental start
Vacancy-day cost ≈ daily rent (industry norm — not client-specific)
numbers.scaling: Per-unit annual → ×250 for single-property chunk → ×10,000 for portfolio chunk. Portfolio figure is directional scale, not a forecast.
numbers.disclaimer: Modeled approximation for prioritization — not measured client ROI or a finance sign-off number.

brief.advantage: Jonah/Engrain ship partner embeds; Entrata pins read the same live rent engine that powers apply and tour scheduling.
brief.why_pursue: High-intent shoppers self-serve on the map; stale third-party pricing loses tours before the agent sees the lead.
